Tata Motors outlines ambitious market share and investment goals

Tata Motors has announced plans to significantly increase its market share in both passenger and commercial vehicle segments, targeting 20% and 40% respectively by FY31 and FY28. The company also plans substantial capital expenditure and is focusing on expanding its electric vehicle offerings and digital services. While domestic growth is a key focus, investor attention remains partly on the performance of Jaguar Land Rover.
